_metadata.description: Incremental pre-release Phase 3 system mapping for all builtin modules except adventure, buildertools, and hytalegenerator

worldgen_modifier.description: Entirely new world generation modifier system. Provides a data-driven framework for modders to modify world-gen-v1 assets (biome covers, layers, environments, fluids, prefabs, tints, cave types, cave covers, cave prefabs) without directly editing base worldgen files. Uses an event-based modifier pipeline with priority ordering and glob-based path matching.
worldgen_modifier.entry_point: Integrated into WorldGenPlugin.setup() - registers asset store, event handlers, codecs, and operations

types.purpose: Root asset type for worldgen modifications. JSON-configured with Priority (event ordering), Target (root folder + glob rules), and Content (map of EventType -> Op[] operations). Registered at path 'WorldGen/Modifier'.

Configures which worldgen root config folder and which asset files to target. Has 'Root' (string, default 'Default') and 'Rules' (string[] of glob patterns). Uses StringUtil.isGlobMatching for path matching.

Core modifier pipeline handler. Thread-local scoped (acquire/close pattern via AutoCloseable). On acquire, collects all WorldGenModifier assets matching a root, sorts by priority + asset pack order, groups operations by EventType. Static handle() method dispatches ModifyEvent through matching modifiers. Uses ListPool for efficient allocation.
Record of (Target, Op[]) representing a single modifier's operations for a specific event type.
Record of (WorldGenModifier, int packPriority) implementing Comparable for sorted modifier ordering. Sorts by EventPriority value, then by asset pack index.

Enum of 10 worldgen modification event types: Biome_Covers, Biome_Environments, Biome_Fluids, Biome_Dynamic_Layers, Biome_Static_Layers, Biome_Prefabs, Biome_Tints, Cave_Types, Cave_Covers, Cave_Prefabs.

Generic interface for worldgen modification events. Extends IEvent<EventType>. Provides type(), file() (FileContext), entries() (mutable List<T>), and loader() (ContentLoader<T>). Has static dispatch() method and nested ContentLoader and SeedGenerator types.

Contains 10 concrete record implementations of ModifyEvent: BiomeCovers, BiomeDynamicLayers, BiomeEnvironments, BiomeFluids, BiomePrefabs, BiomeStaticLayers, BiomeTints, CaveCovers, CavePrefabs, CaveTypes. Each carries the appropriate file context, entry list, and content loader.
Interface for worldgen modification operations. Has apply(ModifyEvent<T>) method. Uses CodecMapCodec with 'Operation' type key. Two implementations: AddOp and RemoveOp.
Operation that adds content to a target content list. Takes a Content object, loads it via the event's ContentLoader, and appends to entries(). Registered as 'Add' on Op.TYPE_CODEC.

Operation that removes matching content from a target content list. Takes 'Rules' (string[] of glob patterns). Special case: '*' clears all entries. Type-specific removal for BiomePrefabs (matches prefab keys), CaveTypes (matches names), CavePrefabs (matches prefab keys). Other types only support '*' clear. Registered as 'Remove' on Op.TYPE_CODEC.
Interface for content that can be loaded by AddOp. Uses CodecMapCodec with 'Type' type key. Returns JsonElement via get(). Single implementation: FileRef.
Content implementation that references a file by dot-separated path within the target worldgen root folder. Serializes as {"File": "path.to.file"}. Registered as 'File' on Content.TYPE_CODEC.

cross_references.worldgen: Registered in WorldGenPlugin.setup(). ASSET_MAP is static on WorldGenModifier. EventHandler.acquire() is called during worldgen loading with the root path.
cross_references.assetstore: WorldGenModifier uses AssetBuilderCodec, DefaultAssetMap, HytaleAssetStore with setIdProvider/setKeyFunction/setReplaceOnRemove pattern.
cross_references.server_worldgen: ModifyEvents records reference worldgen container types: CoverContainer, LayerContainer, EnvironmentContainer, PrefabContainer, TintContainer, WaterContainer, CaveType, CaveNodeType, CavePrefabContainer. RemoveOp has type-specific logic for PrefabContainer.PrefabContainerEntry and CaveType.

design_patterns: Thread-local scoped handler (EventHandler.acquire/close) ensures modifications are applied within worldgen loading context only
Priority-based ordering: EventPriority on modifier, then asset pack registration order
Glob-based targeting: Target.rules uses StringUtil.isGlobMatching for flexible file path matching
Operation pipeline: events flow through sorted modifiers, each applying its Op[] in order
ListPool-based allocation: reuses arrays for Modifier[] and PriorityEntry[] to minimize GC pressure

crafting.summary: Major refactoring: block states (BenchState, ProcessingBenchState) replaced with ECS components (BenchBlock, ProcessingBenchBlock). New BenchSystems class introduced for lifecycle management and ticking. Processing bench gets proper ECS integration with tick-based recipe processing.

types_added.purpose: Block component for crafting benches. Stores tierLevel (int, default 1) and upgradeItems (ItemStack[]). Manages per-bench BenchWindow map (ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, BenchWindow>). Has getBaseBlockType() utility for resolving default state key. Clone-able component.

Block component for processing benches. Stores inputContainer, fuelContainer, outputContainer, recipe tracking, progress, fuel time/state, processing slots. Initialized via initializeBenchConfig(BlockType) and setupSlots(). Handles recipe matching, fuel consumption, progress advancement, and item drops. Very large class (~400 lines) with full processing bench lifecycle.

New container class for bench-related ECS systems. Contains: OnAddOrRemoved (RefSystem<ChunkStore>) for BenchBlock lifecycle with upgrade item drops, ProcessingBenchLifecycle (RefSystem<ChunkStore>) for ProcessingBenchBlock init/teardown with item drops, and ProcessingBenchTick (EntityTickingSystem<ChunkStore>) for time-based recipe processing with fuel, state transitions, and sound effects.

systems_new.purpose: On BenchBlock entity add, checks if current block type has a Bench config - if not, drops upgrade items (bench was replaced with non-bench block). On entity remove (non-unload), closes all windows and drops upgrade items.

On ProcessingBenchBlock entity add, initializes bench config from block type and sets up input/fuel/output slots. On entity remove (unload: marks needs saving; other: drops all container items as item entities).

Ticks processing bench recipe progress. Uses game time delta (WorldTimeResource) for time-based processing. Manages recipe checking, fuel consumption, progress advancement, block interaction state transitions (default/Processing/ProcessCompleted), sound effects, and output item generation.

architectural_notes: BlockState -> Component<ChunkStore> migration for crafting benches parallels the TreasureChestState -> TreasureChestBlock migration in adventure.objectives
Processing bench tick logic extracted from ProcessingBenchState (which had inline tick methods) into BenchSystems.ProcessingBenchTick ECS system
BenchSystems.dropUpgradeItems is a shared utility used by both OnAddOrRemoved and ProcessingBenchLifecycle

fluid.summary: New DisabledFluidResource added for per-world fluid disabling via WorldConfig tags. FluidPlugin updated to register the resource and expose resolveFluidIds utility.

types_added.purpose: ChunkStore resource that caches the set of disabled fluid IDs for a world. Reads WorldConfig.getDisabledFluidTickers() (Set<String> of tag names), resolves to IntSet of fluid asset IDs via FluidPlugin.resolveFluidIds(). Caches result until tags change. Has invalidate() to force re-resolution.

changes: Registers DisabledFluidResource in setup() via chunkStoreRegistry.registerResource()
Added static resolveFluidIds(Set<String>) method that resolves tag names to fluid asset IDs using AssetRegistry.getOrCreateTagIndex() and Fluid asset map tag lookups
Updated fluid ticking systems to check DisabledFluidResource for skipping disabled fluid types
Minor updates to fluid command handling

Registers Op.TYPE_CODEC codecs (AddOp as 'Add', RemoveOp as 'Remove')

cross_module_changes.blockstate_to_component_migration: Both crafting (BenchState/ProcessingBenchState -> BenchBlock/ProcessingBenchBlock) and adventure.objectives (TreasureChestState -> TreasureChestBlock) show a pattern of migrating from the old BlockState system to Component<ChunkStore> ECS components. This is a server-wide architectural shift.
cross_module_changes.worldgen_modifier_ecosystem: The new worldgen modifier system is a significant modding-facing feature: allows data-driven modification of biome covers, layers, environments, fluids, prefabs, tints, and cave configurations via Add/Remove operations with glob-based targeting.
cross_module_changes.disabled_fluid_system: New DisabledFluidResource in fluid module + WorldConfig.getDisabledFluidTickers() enables per-world fluid type disabling via tags.
